The integrated approach

One direction.
Three disciplines.

When a business presents itself through a brand, a product, and a digital experience, those decisions need to support the same idea. We consider them together so each part makes the others clearer.

01 / Brand

Brand

Meaning, distinction, and a language that teams can use consistently.

Direction → identity system

02 / Product

Product

Form, use, and production decisions that make the physical offer real.

Concept → manufacturable detail

03 / Digital

Digital

Journeys and interfaces that help people understand and use the offer.

Experience → reusable patterns

Capabilities

The right disciplines for the problem.

Some engagements need one focused capability. Others need a shared direction across several. The scope follows the decisions at hand.

01Brand systemsFor a company whose offer, audience, or ambition has moved beyond its current identity.↗02Product & industrial designFor a physical offer that needs a coherent form, material language, and path toward making.↗03Digital experiencesFor websites and digital products that need clearer journeys, interfaces, and content structure.↗04Visual contentFor teams that need photography, video, 3D, or imagery to explain a product or identity.↗

The approach

Make the decisions clear. Then make the system work.

We begin by understanding the business, the people it serves, and the constraints around the work. Concepts become a system only when the choices behind them are clear enough to implement and maintain.

  1. 01InvestigateFind the problem worth solving.
  2. 02DecideAgree on principles and priorities.
  3. 03BuildDevelop the identity, product, or experience.
  4. 04GovernSupport use, evaluation, and evolution.

The studio

Close to the work. Accountable to the decisions.

HS108 is an independent studio based in India. The proposed working model puts experienced design direction, direct discussion, and practical systems at the centre of an engagement.

01 / Direction

Business context first.

Define what the work must change before choosing its form.

02 / Collaboration

Clear decisions together.

Keep the client close to the reasoning, tradeoffs, and next steps.

03 / Continuity

Built to be used.

Document and support the system beyond its first presentation.
